payload.title: Pretext staging build fails: cookies() called outside a request scope during prerender of /[year]/[month]/[day]
payload.description: Threat Intelligence new app dzefa11i80jyq, Amplify branch `staging` job 1 (2026-10-08 ~00:0xZ) fails in `next build` page data collection/prerender of `/[year]/[month]/[day]` with "cookies was called outside a request scope". In staging (SITE_ENV=staging) Papyrus reads the session cookie per request; Next tries to prerender the page at build time. Fix: make Pretext reader routes dynamic in staging without changing production or other brands.
